body.statement:
Under the declared Job Corps assignment, support, randomization, consistency, no-defiers, complier-conditional selection-monotonicity, and \(M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\geq m_*>0\) restrictions, let \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), set \(p_0=p(P_0)\), and impose the declared relative-interior and tangent-image conditions.  The response-type fiber computes the separate same-law endpoints and proves
\[
 \Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p_0)
 \subseteq\prod_{t\in\mathcal T}
 [\underline\Delta(t;p_0),\overline\Delta(t;p_0)],
\]
with no rectangle-equality claim.  The completed tangent cells define a lawful \(\mathfrak G_0\in\mathfrak E\) with nonempty \(H_{r_0}\).  Under the sampled-data assumptions, Carter's theorem gives unconditional fixed-compact transfer, and \(\mathrm{lem:moving\mbox{-}offset\mbox{-}carter\mbox{-}geometry}\) gives unconditional moving-offset comparison for any supplied Gaussian rule.  A finite replayable moving-offset rule is available only if the affirmative conclusion specified in \(\mathrm{oeq:effective\mbox{-}compatible\mbox{-}density}\), or a separately proved sufficient compatibility package, is available.  Under zero-offset centering, the diagonally selected expanding lawful windows satisfy
\[
 M_n^{\diamond}\to M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0),
 \qquad
 \liminf_nM_n\geq M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
The window selection is not claimed computable.  Under the same compatibility conditional, \(\operatorname{CertGluePFL}\) returns an \(\varepsilon\)-accurate replayable Gaussian certificate, and its ingredients can be transferred on any already selected window.  No globally honest unbounded sampled-data primal, global \(\limsup_nM_n\), or two-sided global multinomial minimax limit is asserted.
body.justification: The proposition retains exact same-law causal identification, lawful tangent geometry, compact transfer, and conditional replayable Gaussian certification.
body.gap: A global unbounded sampled-data primal and global two-sided minimax convergence are no longer promised.
body.consumer: The workflow supports simultaneous ordered-wage assertions with an expanding-window sampled-data receipt and no rectangle-equality overclaim.
body.proof_tex:
\textbf{Technique: composition of exact finite-fiber identification, rational tangent geometry, and the compact transfer results.}
Let \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) and \(p_0=p(P_0)\).  The assignment, support, randomization, three consistency conditions, no-defiers, complier-conditional selection monotonicity, and aggregate positivity are the separately declared restrictions defining \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\).  In particular,
\[
 M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\geq m_*>0,
 \tag{52}
\]
so every conditional quantile in the target has a positive denominator.

The causal polyhedralization theorem identifies the selected-complier submeasures and proves that the response-type polytope represents exactly \(\mathcal F(p_0)\).  The lower- and upper-endpoint attainment propositions give, for each fixed \(t\in\mathcal T\), same-law witnesses satisfying
\[
 Q_{1,P_t^-(p_0)}(t)-Q_{0,P_t^-(p_0)}(t)
 =\underline\Delta(t;p_0),
 \tag{53}
\]
\[
 Q_{1,P_t^+(p_0)}(t)-Q_{0,P_t^+(p_0)}(t)
 =\overline\Delta(t;p_0).
 \tag{54}
\]
For an arbitrary single \(P\in\mathcal F(p_0)\), the definitions of the infimum and supremum give
\[
 \underline\Delta(t;p_0)
 \leq Q_{1,P}(t)-Q_{0,P}(t)
 \leq\overline\Delta(t;p_0).
 \tag{55}
\]
Taking all coordinates and then all compatible laws in (55) proves
\[
 \Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p_0)
 \subseteq\prod_{t\in\mathcal T}
 [\underline\Delta(t;p_0),\overline\Delta(t;p_0)].
 \tag{56}
\]
The witnesses in (53)--(54) may depend on \(t\) and on the endpoint, so (56) is only an outer rectangle and not a Cartesian sharpness assertion.

Under relative interiority and tangent-image compatibility, the tangent-cover proposition gives \(\bigcup_vD_v^0=\mathbb R^d\).  For every nonzero \(x\in\mathbb R^d\), multinomial positivity and full column rank of \(B\) give
\[
 x'I_0x=\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}
 \frac{\{(Bx)_j\}^2}{(p_0)_j}>0.
 \tag{57}
\]
Thus \(I_0\succ0\), \(\Sigma_0=I_0^{-1}\succ0\), and rationality of \(p_0\) and \(B\) makes \(\Sigma_0\) rational.  The radius proposition supplies \(H_{r_0}\neq\varnothing\).  These facts are exactly the cover, covariance, and separated-domain conditions of \(\mathfrak E\), so
\[
 \mathfrak G_0\in\mathfrak E.
 \tag{58}
\]

The fixed-stratum theorem gives Carter's compact comparison and the sharpened charge \(C_{2/\kappa}m\log(m)/\sqrt n+(H_C+A_0)x_n(C)+\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)\), with semantic and covariance terms displayed separately.  For moving offsets, the unconditional moving-offset Carter--geometry lemma applies to any supplied Gaussian rule and yields the linear charge \((H_C+2A_0)\overline\chi_n(C)\).  The existence of a finite replayable Gaussian rule at the moving offset is not inferred from this comparison: it follows only under the affirmative ECD conclusion, or under a separately proved sufficient compatibility package, through the conditional CertGlue theorem and the moving-offset theorem.

Under zero-offset centering, compact exhaustion proves
\[
 M_n^\diamond\longrightarrow M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0),
 \qquad
 \liminf_{n\to\infty}M_n
 \geq M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
 \tag{59}
\]
The radii in (59) are selected by a diagonal existence argument; no modulus for the required compact suprema or lawful-ball inclusion is supplied by the standing assumptions.  Under the same ECD conditional, CertGlue returns the replayable Gaussian primal, atomic dual, outward endpoints, and repair ingredients at any already selected window.  Finally, the escaping-boundary lemma proves that compact comparison cannot supply a global sampled-data upper bound.  Therefore (59) is not enlarged to a global \(\limsup\), a globally honest unbounded transferred primal, or a two-sided global minimax limit.
